## Try Perfm

Download `Perfm-<version>-Windows-x64.zip` below and extract the entire ZIP. Run `Perfm.exe` from the extracted folder. Keep the `SensorBridge` folder beside it so hardware sensors work.

Perfm runs on 64-bit Windows. The standard package does not require a .NET runtime. To request administrator access for additional hardware sensors, run `Run Perfm with CPU sensors.cmd` instead.

The matching `.sha256` file contains the ZIP's SHA-256 checksum.
